decoder_protocol: Every within-test same-vessel cross-product pair, both directions, equal vessel weights. Latent replacement means use factor_fit only. Summary is the arithmetic mean over two seeds per arm.
donor_protocol: Same-class different-vessel test donors, fixed seed41033, uniform donor vessel then observation. Products unrestricted; coverage and matched-subset actual-pair references are reported.
auxiliary_protocol: Frozen Ds/Dc checkpoints on test-only vessel_targets: equal-product shared mean and x-minus-mean. Only multi-product vessels, observations averaged within vessel then vessels equally. Zero-baseline skills in percent; sum reconstructed x is also reported. self_aux supervises only the sum, so separate components need not be identified. Shared targets include the focal acquisition and are empirical diagnostic proxies, not causal content.
capacity_protocol: Fixed original classifier and basis; original 464 errors only. scale effects=(h@basis)*basis.T@weight; residual uses source gate-fit RMS(h@basis) instead. Independent per-image label-informed oracle_margin at fixed closed bounds [-0.1,0.1]. This is an optimistic outer bound of the tanh gate, ignoring context learnability. Only margins>1e-7 count as correctable; near-zero margins are recorded separately. Remaining error floor retains all original correct rows via feasible zero gain; no capacity LP is run on those rows. Capacity is independent of factor arm and seed. NOT DEPLOYABLE, not target support-adapted accuracy, no label-based hyperparameter selection.
